display.entryTitle: Piano Room Thin Green Book Spine Mickey

description: In the piano room, the bookcase on the right holds Pluto's Republic. Just left of it is a thin green book with a yellow Mickey at the top of its spine.

whereToLook.scene: The piano room, the bookcase on the right
whereToLook.exactSpot: The thin green book immediately left of Pluto's Republic. Yellow Mickey at the top of the spine.

bestTip: Find Pluto's Republic first, then slide one book left.
